outlook.statement: Soap and detergent demand rising due to improved hygiene awareness, cleanliness emphasis, lifestyle shift from semi-urban to metropolitan areas, population expansion, and increased rural market demand. Shift from powdered to liquid detergents increasing LABSA 96% demand. Domestic LAB demand expected to climb continuously. Caustic Soda market expected to grow with alumina, textiles, apparel demand from urbanization and personal care expenditure. PO domestic demand anticipated to recover from Q2 FY 2026-27. India GDP growth estimated at 7.6% FY 2025-26, targeting $5 trillion economy by 2027.

Pricing and margins may continue to be influenced by macroeconomic climate typified by geopolitical conflicts; detergent manufacturers looking at alternatives for LAB which may stagnate growth; greater supply than demand in FY 2026, China's return to export market, and Europe's production normalization will impact Caustic Lye prices with margin erosion projected; PO demand expected to improve in coming months
About 3 crore units of solar power is being augmented and will be available from Oct-2026.

TPL has also initiated installation of rotary UPS in the energy distribution network, which will facilitate higher utilisation of renewable energy. This will be implemented in two phases. The first phase is likely to be commissioned by mid of FY 2027-28.
The Company has developed a road map to reduce CO2 emissions by about 81% from the base line by 20245.
Low pressure operation and optimization of prefractionation section of LAB unit to reduce Scope 1 CO2 by 2800 MT per year.
Flare gas recovery project execution is in progress to conserve LNG and improve the heat recovery in process heater, thereby reducing 1700 MT CO2 per year under scope 1.
Renewable power to be enhanced by 3 crore units. The process will get completed by end of FY 2026-27. The annual reduction of CO2 under scope 2 will be 21300 MT.

Flare gas recovery project and power back-up system to enable switching of LNG based generator and utilization of renewable power are expected to be completed in slightly more than a year, with benefits accruing from the following financial year.

NEERI's feasibility study to introduce ZLD in phased manner at PO plant is under progress by exploring adoption of Advanced Oxidation process and RDRO system for recovery & maximum reuse of treated effluent.

In a Suo Moto case filed by NGT, the Company was imposed an environmental compensation of ₹ 100 lakh each towards LAB and HCD units by TNPCB in the year 2020. The Company has submitted its representation for consideration with TNPCB and awaiting further directions.
Carbon Emission - Risk & Opportunity: CO2 emissions contribute to climate change. Failing to meet decarbonization commitments can lead to reputational risks.

Toxic Emissions - Risk: Toxic emissions can cause significant harm to the Company & neighbouring locality, resulting in health hazards, plant downtime, financial losses, legal challenges, reputational damage, regulatory complications.

Hazardous Waste and Wastewater management - Risk: Inadequate management can lead to contamination of soil and water resources, fines and penalties, increased liability risk, increased operational costs, closure of facility.

Labour Management - Risk: Inability to meet workforce expectations may impact retention rate and business continuity, causing reputational risk and productivity issues. New labor codes expected to bring more challenges.

Chemical Safety - Risk: Inadequate chemical safety measures may lead to potential costs related to accidents, causing damage to men, materials & surrounding settlements leading to potential legal liabilities, regulatory penalties, and reputational damage.
